This file documents declared operations at the shell, one section per command. Every command is a subcommand of =role_request_operations=, and every section exports its own script into =projects/ores.shell/scripts/library/=. Loading a script runs that one command, so a failure names the command it came from.

** =ask-for-roles=
:PROPERTIES:
:ID: B12E0E7B-76CA-5106-956C-0A01D4F938A6
:END:

Sends =ask_for_roles_request= and prints =ask_for_roles_response=, so the shape is the protocol's and the meaning is the service's. It reads =role_ids=, =reason=, in that order. The caller must have established a session first.


The command is shaped like this:

#+begin_example
role_request_operations ask-for-roles <role_ids> <reason>
#+end_example

It is addressed at =iam.v1.ops.ask_for_roles=.
